sin.name: nudge-words-in-test
sin.description: A test checks that a nudge reached the agent by a string of the nudge's own words, so it fails when the words are reworded and passes when another line contains the same words.
sin.rule: Check the nudge by the registry: nudge_reached(app, text, Nudges.NAME, value=...) from tests/nudge_lines.py finds the nudger's entry for that nudge with those values and its line in the text the agent was sent.
